steps.caption: Click Search at the top of the sidebar.
Two modes: Search everything (words), and Find accounts (describe companies you want).
Type a word — here a company name — and press Search.
Results of every type: lease, company, signal, requirement, meetings…
Each keeps its status — reported, confirmed or hypothesis are never mixed.
You only see what your access allows.
Narrow it: choose a type — Lease.
More filters: place, from/to dates, status and source.
Press Search — only leases in Kharadi remain.
Click any result to open it.
